mapper.select: SELECT growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", level_no AS "levelNo", level_name AS "levelName", min_exp AS "minExp", max_exp AS "maxExp", tree_image_path AS "treeImagePath" FROM growth_levels ORDER BY level_no ASC

SELECT t.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", t.growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", g.level_no AS "levelNo", g.level_name AS "levelName", t.total_exp AS "totalExp", g.tree_image_path AS "treeImagePath" FROM growth_tree t JOIN growth_levels g ON t.growth_level_id = g.growth_level_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_tree(workspace_growth_id, workspace_id, month, growth_level_id, total_exp, updated_at) VALUES(SEQ_WORKSPACE_GROWTH.NEXTVAL, #{workspaceId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM'), (SELECT growth_level_id FROM growth_levels WHERE min_exp <=0 AND (max_exp IS NULL OR max_exp >=0) ), 0, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_GROWTH_EXP_LOGS.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO growth_exp_logs( exp_log_id, workspace_id, member_id, notice_id, exp, action_type, earned_at, invite_key) VALUES(#{expLogId}, #{workspaceId}, #{memberId}, #{noticeId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{exp}, #{actionType}, SYSDATE, #{inviteKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id AS "workspaceId", growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", total_exp AS "totalExp" FROM growth_tree WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_tree SET total_exp = #{totalExp}, growth_level_id = #{growthLevelId}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
